title: 第3章 前世今生挑选大椿功第4章 筑基种子待遇族长大手笔
slug: 炼气期如履薄冰元婴期重拳出击
content_zh:
晚上，母亲陈秀云做了一顿丰盛晚餐，用来庆祝。
这顿晚餐的丰盛之处，不在于菜肴，而是米饭。
“哇，灵米！”李青元看着满满一大盆灵米，垂涎欲滴。
灵米珍贵，价格不低。
一般只有逢年过节的时候，或有大喜事的时候，家里才会吃上一顿。
陈秀云温婉一笑，看着儿子说：“祖宗保佑，元儿不仅拥有灵根，还是四灵根。”
“我家青元，将来一定可以成为炼气中期修士，成为修成灵识，可以御剑飞行的仙师。”
李定舟、李青元父子相视一眼，默契一笑。
李定舟心中暗自得意：【炼气中期算什么，青元将来最低也得是炼气后期高手，甚至可以尝试冲击筑基。】
【毕竟青元可是三灵根中的上品，资质十分接近双灵根。】
如果双灵根，是金属性、木属性，金克木。
这种双灵根，属性相克。
三种属性相生的木、火、土三灵根，修炼速度不低于属性相克的双灵根了。
陈秀云不断给儿子夹菜，关心道：“元儿，多吃点。”
李青元狼吞虎咽，不忘夸赞一声：“娘的厨艺，真是越来越好了。”
这一世的父母，李青元很喜欢，他们让他感受到了家的温暖。
吃饱喝足后，一家三口庭院散步。
李定舟作为家族炼气三层修士，族中地位虽然不是特别的高，但也不低，拥有一座独立小院。
散步消食后，洗漱睡觉。
李青元自己睡，卧室在偏房，他拥有自己的房间。

这一晚，李青元睡得格外香甜。
因为，他有灵根了。
不过，他又做噩梦了。
梦中的他，是个婴儿，因为先天性心脏病，被亲生父母抛弃。
好冷、好饿。
后来，他被好心人送到警察局，然后又被送到福利院，侥幸活了下来。
但他自幼体弱多病，心脏功能衰弱，导致血液活力不足。
供血不足，导致气血不足，脾胃虚寒，手脚冰凉，惧怕冬天。
即便后来，有好心人资助他读完高中、大学毕业，才工作两年不到的他，心脏病恶化，直接猝死。
“啊！”
李青元突然醒来，满头大汗。
content_en:
In the evening, mother Chen Xiuyun cooked a sumptuous dinner to celebrate.
The richness of this dinner is not the dishes, but the rice.
"Wow, spiritual rice!" Li Qingyuan looked at the large basin full of spiritual rice, salivating.
Lingmi is precious and the price is not low.
Usually only during festivals or special events, the family will have a meal.
Chen Xiuyun smiled gently, looked at her son and said, "With the blessing of our ancestors, Yuan'er not only has spiritual roots, but also four spiritual roots."
"My Qingyuan will definitely become a mid-stage Qi refining monk in the future, an immortal master who has mastered spiritual consciousness and can fly with a sword."
Li Dingzhou, Li Qingyuan and his son looked at each other and smiled in understanding.
Li Dingzhou was secretly proud in his heart: [What is the middle stage of Qi refining? In the future, Qingyuan will at least be a master in the late stage of Qi refining, and he can even try to attack the foundation. 】
[After all, Qing Yuan is the top grade among the three spiritual roots, and his qualifications are very close to those of the two spiritual roots. 】
If there are two spiritual roots, they are metallic and wood, and metal overcomes wood.
These two spiritual roots have mutually incompatible attributes.
The cultivation speed of the three spiritual roots of wood, fire and earth, whose three attributes are incompatible with each other, is no less than that of the two spiritual roots whose attributes are incompatible.
Chen Xiuyun kept picking up food for her son and said with concern: "Yuan'er, eat more."
Li Qingyuan devoured the food and did not forget to praise: "My mother's cooking skills are getting better and better."
Li Qingyuan liked his parents very much in this life. They made him feel the warmth of home.
After eating and drinking, the family of three took a walk in the courtyard.
Li Dingzhou is a third-level monk in the family's Qi Refining. Although his status in the family is not particularly high, it is not low either. He owns an independent small courtyard.
After taking a walk to digest food, wash up and go to bed.
Li Qingyuan sleeps by himself. The bedroom is in the side room and he has his own room.
That night, Li Qingyuan slept particularly soundly.
Because he has spiritual roots.
However, he had another nightmare.
In the dream, he was a baby who was abandoned by his biological parents because of congenital heart disease.
So cold and so hungry.
Later, he was sent to the police station by well-wishers, and then to an orphanage. He survived by luck.
However, he had been frail and sick since childhood, and his heart function was weak, resulting in insufficient blood vitality.
Insufficient blood supply leads to insufficient qi and blood, cold spleen and stomach, cold hands and feet, and fear of winter.
Even later, some kind people helped him finish high school and graduate from college. After working for less than two years, his heart disease worsened and he died suddenly.
"Ah!"
Li Qingyuan woke up suddenly, sweating profusely.
